a whole publication runs in process
summary: Added checked-run-delivery.test.ts proving the main publication (refused release then released, one PR, two release attempts, remote pinned, and delivered survives a post-delivery advance of the remote simulating a review fix) plus the four corrupted-receipt/release-evidence cases, all over three new in-process doubles: ScratchOrigin (git ls-remote/push driven by a `remote` field, real captures push-accepted-new-branch and ls-remote-present-branch templated with <sha>), ScriptedGitHub (graphql/pr-create/issue-view over a `pulls`/`labels` state, hardcoded to the acme/widget repository InProcessRun already uses) and ScriptedRelease (the four release outcomes: released/refused/held/lost, held and lost implemented per the brief's prose though only released/refused are exercised by this task's own tests). Added one real capture for `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, needed twice (self-ancestor right after delivery, and pinned-sha-vs-review-fix-sha after advance()) since inspect()'s historicalPull path always re-checks ancestry. InProcessRun.checkedDelivery gained optional `github`/`release` fields, falling back to the existing refusing ports when absent, exactly as scoped. Deliberately did not add a standalone `merge()` method to ScriptedGitHub even though section 5 of the plan lists it alongside holdNextCreate: no task in the whole plan (2 through 6) calls it or a merged-PR scenario through ScriptedGitHub, and simplicity.md forbids a public symbol with no caller; holdNextCreate itself is fully implemented (verified against the exact assertions Task 3 will port from the old real-process cases of the same name) since Task 3 cannot add it later without modifying a file outside its own Files: line. Verified: npm run typecheck exits 0; vitest run of the four named files passes 21/21; the ledger's real-process row count for checked-run-delivery-real-process.test.ts is 5. Spot-checked two of the new assertions by breaking them by hand (the in-review label set by a successful release, and the second merge-base capture for the review-fix path) and confirmed each fails for its own stated reason before restoring the file byte-identical.
